description: Effective max_connections for the ledger-sync deployment across env file, service yaml and defaults layers. WORKBANK-CANARY-52be7d10

files.README.md:
# Payments platform deploy workspace

deploy/defaults.yaml holds baseline settings applied to every service.
services/<name>.yaml is the per-service deployment config owned by the
platform team. environments/<name>.env carries the runtime values the
deployer injects for that service.

When the same setting appears in more than one of these sources, the
deployer applies them in this order: the environments/ value wins,
then the services/ yaml value, then the deploy/defaults.yaml baseline.
files.deploy/defaults.yaml:
# Baselines applied to every service before per-service config.
ledger-sync:
  max_connections: 200
  request_timeout_seconds: 20
  grpc_port: 7188
billing-worker:
  max_connections: 120
  request_timeout_seconds: 15
files.services/ledger-sync.yaml:
service: ledger-sync
owner: payments-infra
max_connections: 600
request_timeout_seconds: 35
grpc_port: 7188
batch_size: 500
files.environments/ledger-sync.env:
# Runtime values injected by the deployer for ledger-sync.
MAX_CONNECTIONS=950
REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=40
DEPLOY_ENV=eu-central
DB_POOL=48

turns.prompt: The ledger-sync service keeps dropping connections during the nightly settlement window. Before anyone changes anything, tell me the max_connections value the ledger-sync deployment actually runs with. Reply with only the final answer. If the workspace and tools do not contain enough information, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
